prompt_rules: Character eligibility is semantic: use only fictional characters.
Preserve recognizable identity and the requested version's canonical outfit.
Use beautiful once as a soft reinforcement, never as the subject.
Describe composition with viewpoint and framing only.
Never use camera, camera angle, lens, photographer, filming or physical photographic equipment.
Vary poses, situations, settings, expressions, actions and viewpoints.
Keep the Klein prompt focused on preserving identity, outfit, pose, viewpoint and framing while adding realistic finish.
dataset_prepare.next_action: The Master must author 5-10 entries at a time, call append_character_dataset_entries for each chunk, then call finalize_character_dataset once all entries are staged. When character_profile_used is true, use its characteristics and clothing as local identity facts, without mechanically concatenating tags or contradicting them. Do not call search or cache tools automatically. The returned character_profile is already the local lookup result: continue directly to authoring and append_character_dataset_entries. Call get_character_profile only when the user explicitly requests profile inspection or debugging.
